applicable_programme.grade_mapping_note: PYP = K-5 here, MYP = 6-10, DP/CP = 11-12. Grade mapping is our convention (label C), not an IB statement.
applicable_programme.shared_programme_block_ref: doc_id or block id of the shared programme-level block (decision D2), or null

grade_specific_note.label: C
grade_specific_note.text: short note for this grade only

subject_group_or_structure.ib_subject_group_or_area: official IB name (e.g. 'Language' in PYP, 'Language and literature' in MYP)
subject_group_or_structure.mapping_to_primer_subject: how it relates to our subject
subject_group_or_structure.mapping_label: C  (every judgment call in the mapping is ours)

typical_fit.label: C
typical_fit.text: where this typically fits at this grade, framed as typical

access_limitations: List any resource behind educator login or copyright limits, with the access limitation. Never reconstruct restricted content from memory.

_instructions.labels: A = official state standard. B = official IB framework or programme requirement. C = suggested alignment, unit idea, bridge or summary written by us (never official).

envelope.schema_version: Template version this document follows. Currently 0.1.0 (draft until Phase 1 finalizes it).
envelope.doc_id: Unique id, derived from the path. Examples: fl.grade-03.ela, az.grade-03.ela, ib.pyp.grade-03.ela, ib.dp-cp.grade-11.ela, xw.grade-03.ela. Kindergarten uses 'kindergarten'. The build script rejects an id that does not match the file path.
envelope.doc_type: state_standards | ib_alignment | crosswalk | summary | source_log | meta.
envelope.system: florida | arizona | ib | crosswalk. null only for summary, source_log and meta documents.
envelope.programme: null for Florida, Arizona, crosswalk. For IB: PYP (K-5), MYP (6-10) or DP_CP (11-12).
envelope.subject: ela | mathematics | science | social-studies. Arizona calls social studies 'History and Social Science'; keep the slug and record the official name in sections.grade_and_subject.
envelope.status: not_started | in_progress | drafted | reviewed | approved. Above not_started needs at least one citation.
envelope.content_labels: List of A, B, C present in the document. Florida/Arizona docs: A and C only. IB docs: B and C only. Crosswalks: any, but their own text is C.
envelope.citations: List of citation objects. Every document carries its own citations, not just a master bibliography. Fields: id, url, title, publisher, published_or_version_date, page, access_date, access_limitation.
envelope.version_notes: List of short strings: what changed, when, and why. Append, do not rewrite.
envelope.last_updated: YYYY-MM-DD of the last content change.

_instructions.critical_distinction: IB is a programme framework, not a grade-by-grade checklist. Never label an IB item an official 'Grade X standard' unless a public official IB source explicitly says so. Grade placement here is our convention and is label C.
_instructions.sections.applicable_programme: Which programme applies and why. shared_programme_block_ref supports decision D2 (avoid copying the same PYP text into six grade files).
_instructions.sections.subject_group_or_structure: IB subject groups do not map one-to-one to our four subjects (decision D3). Every mapping judgment is label C.
_instructions.sections.framework_elements: Lists drawn from official IB documents only. Cite each source in citations.
_instructions.sections.official_requirements: Label B only. Each item needs citation_ids. If the source is restricted, put it in access_limitations instead.
_instructions.sections.typical_fit: Label C. Say 'typically' and avoid claiming IB requires it at this grade.
_instructions.sections.access_limitations: Honest list of what we could not read and why.
quality_rules: No B label without a citation.
